probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, and __a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes and positioned to preferentially direct light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body__.

2. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __and wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section__.

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body __and wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body__.

6. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __and wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body__.

7. (Cancelled)

8. (Cancelled)

9. (Cancelled)

10. (Cancelled)

11. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK __and wherein a single light emitting diode resides on each face of said columnar body__.

12. (Cancelled)

13. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base __and wherein said lamp has a general A19 outline__.

14. (Cancelled)

15. (Cancelled)

16. (Cancelled)

17. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body, providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode, __and applying a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diode__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK __and wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls __and wherein a single diode is mounted to each side of said body__.

20. (Cancelled)
